name: How long does bathroom drywall repair take from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How long does bathroom drywall repair take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard bathroom drywall repair typically takes one to three days to finish completely. While cutting out damaged sections and hanging replacement boards can take only a few hours, applying joint compound requires multiple thin coats. Each layer of mud needs adequate drying time before sanding and applying the next coat, particularly in high-humidity bathroom environments. Rushing this process by painting over damp compound often causes peeling paint and visible seam cracking later on.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most bathroom drywall repairs take one to three days. The process requires hanging new board, followed by multiple coats of compound that each need proper drying time before painting.
